materials.RockBare: Bare underwater seabed rock face, tight even granite-like grain, subtle mineral speckle.
materials.RockCracked: Fractured underwater stone with a fine network of dark hairline cracks between flat plates.
materials.RockFacet: Angular basalt-like rock broken into broad chiselled flat facets of varying tilt.
materials.SandRipple: Fine current-swept seabed sand with gentle regular parallel ripples, small grain.
materials.Gravel: Packed seabed gravel of small rounded pebbles with dark grit seams between them.
materials.SiltSmooth: Soft smooth deep-sea silt and ooze, very low relief, faint gentle undulations.
materials.MudCracks: Dried cracked sediment plates split by a network of wide dark shrinkage cracks.
materials.Cobble: Rounded seabed cobblestones packed together with deep dark crevices between the stones.
materials.Strata: Fine horizontal sedimentary rock strata, many thin parallel layered bands of stone.
materials.MossAlgae: Soft patchy marine algae and moss over rock, muted desaturated green, speckled edges.
materials.CoralCrust: Knobbly encrusting brain-coral over rock, rounded bumpy lobes with fine pores, faint warm tone.
materials.Barnacles: Dense crust of small conical barnacles on rock, raised rings with dark central apertures.
materials.TubeWorms: Bed of small marine tube-worm and polyp openings, raised pale rims around dark holes.
materials.RustStain: Iron-oxide rust staining mottled over submerged metal-bearing rock, warm blotches, pitting.
materials.FossilBed: Scattered shell and ammonite fossil impressions in pale sedimentary stone, concentric ridges.

decals.Protrusion: A single chunky rounded rock protrusion knob outcrop lump, greyish stone.
decals.Overhang: A single jutting rock ledge shelf overhang slab of grey stone, wider at the outer edge.
decals.BoulderLump: A single rounded mossy boulder lump of grey rock.
decals.FossilAmmonite: A single spiral ammonite fossil shell pressed into grey stone, ridged coil.
decals.FossilBone: A single fossilized bone / vertebra fragment embedded in pale stone.
decals.ShellCluster: A small tight cluster of clam and scallop shells on the seabed.
decals.CoralBranch: A single branching staghorn coral clump, pale tan branches.
decals.CoralBrain: A single round brain coral head with maze-like grooves.
decals.CoralFan: A single flat sea fan gorgonian coral, lacy branching mesh.
decals.Anemone: A single sea anemone with a ring of soft tentacles, muted colour.
decals.BarnacleClump: A small clustered clump of conical barnacles.
decals.TubeWormTuft: A small bundle of feather-duster tube worms with soft crowns.
decals.SpongeBarrel: A single barrel sponge, rough porous cylinder, muted colour.
decals.Vent: A single hydrothermal vent chimney opening in dark rock, crusted rim, dark hole.
decals.Crack: A single deep jagged crack fissure crevice in grey rock, dark interior.
